description: This file defines a C# class 'ControllableTestAdapterFactory' implementing multiple Orleans interfaces for stream provider control, including command execution and factory creation, along with an enum for commands.

classes.name: ControllableTestStreamProviderCommands
classes.description: Enum defining command identifiers for the controllable stream provider, including AdapterEcho and AdapterFactoryEcho.

classes.name: ControllableTestAdapterFactory
classes.description: A class implementing IQueueAdapter, IQueueAdapterFactory, and IControllable to facilitate controllable stream adapter creation and command execution within Orleans.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a batch of messages for a specific stream.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver for a specific queue; not implemented in this class.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache for the queue adapter; not implemented.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns a stream queue mapper configured with a hash ring and zero total queues.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Provides a handler for delivery failures; not implemented.

methods.name: ExecuteCommand
methods.description: Executes a command based on the provided command ID and argument, returning a task with the result.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ControllableTestAdapterFactory using dependency injection.
